choices.label: One node containing only a word’s final character.

choices.label: A sorted list of all characters without their order.

questions.prompt: What must distinguish a complete word from a stored prefix?

choices.label: The number of children at its final node.
choices.feedback: A path may exist only because it is the beginning of a longer word; a complete-word search needs the marker.

choices.label: A separate end-of-word marker at its final node.
choices.feedback: A path may exist only because it is the beginning of a longer word; a complete-word search needs the marker.

choices.label: The mere existence of its character path.
choices.feedback: A path may exist only because it is the beginning of a longer word; a complete-word search needs the marker.

questions.prompt: What does a prefix query need to verify?

choices.label: That every character edge in the prefix exists.
choices.feedback: A prefix does not need to be a whole stored word; reaching its final character is sufficient.

choices.label: That the final node also has an end-of-word marker.
choices.feedback: A prefix does not need to be a whole stored word; reaching its final character is sufficient.

choices.label: That the prefix is longer than every stored word.
